meta.title: DSH QoL Pack
meta.description: Quality-of-life details: the four kinds of reporting stay off until you turn them on; Changes, Git, Project and Memory views beside the chat; global memory, a local skill library and usage statistics in Settings; deleting archived sessions; in-app updates; Git and pull-request tools for the assistant (writes need approval) with result cards; project and global memory injected into every session.
